integrity: The quantitative formulas are proved from complete palindrome-run classification. Prior qualitative run-length richness criteria and published length-eight example are credited. No independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary words only, at most six runs; global minimal non-rich classification not claimed; the seven-run case is one sharp example. Computation is finite corroboration. The 2016 final journal article has not been compared in full to the available 2015 associated preprint.
title: Exact palindromic defect and minimal obstructions for binary words with at most six runs
